title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is Chet Baker’s “Time After Time” — a smoky jazz standard with gentle phrasing, intimate late-night warmth, and a timeless romantic glow. It gives Djembe a softer feature moment for the room: close, classy, and full of feeling.
songListNote: Chet Baker’s intimate jazz-standard reading, bringing smoky late-night warmth, romance, and classic lounge elegance to the show rotation.
